description: OPTIONAL isolated representation study (count-only, never builds a graph): measured memory of the implicit representation (CGAL index; final_representation_bytes, index_build_peak_bytes, pipeline_peak_bytes) against the analytical size an explicit representation WOULD need (explicit_csr_bytes_estimate, explicit_bitmatrix_bytes_estimate), with |E| counted by streaming radius queries. Marathe only, because its work is a plain BFS + level MIS and it scales to n = 50,000. Not part of the primary comparison.
